data.narrative:
LabGenius, a Seed-stage biotech company founded by James Field, has raised $73M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 3 public peers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private companies in Biotech & Health, including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

Stage-progression methodology is the applicable triangulation approach. Using total capital raised as a proxy base value of $27M and applying a typical Seed-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 2.5x yields an implied valuation of $68M. This method assumes capital deployment and near-term milestone achievement consistent with the stage transition.

Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied; while the Biotech & Health sector median trades at 9.2x P/S across the three public comps, LabGenius does not disclose revenue, which is standard for private firms. A peer-median approach is similarly inapplicable due to insufficient datapoints within tight stage and valuation-tier filters across the broader private peer set. The analysis therefore relies on a single method, generating a range of $57M to $78M with a median of $68M. Key uncertainties stem from the limited methodological coverage and the absence of revenue visibility. Stage progression assumes predictable milestones; deviations in R&D efficiency, clinical outcomes, or capital efficiency would materially alter the valuation.
